did: I took over home's lane work. First I fixed the render test that kept failing at random on other people's pull requests. The cause was in the test: it read a process id from a file while the fake recorder was still writing it, got nothing, and then mistook the kernel's CPU counters for a live process. That fix is merged. Then I built a check that warns when deploying to home if every service's memory limit added up is more than home's memory. Today they add up to about 30 GiB. Three independent reviews hardened it, and it waits on its tests. I also added a one-line pointer to the coordinate skill in the server's guide.
left: The memory check only warns for now. It becomes a refusal once home's real memory is published each night, which needs the dotfiles repo, and once you decide whether ollama counts.
The invariants doc, #823, waits for the contention guard to merge, then a small rebase and review by the next session.
waits: Whether ollama runs on home, and so whether its 8 GiB counts against home's memory (D3).
A redeploy, so renders that obey the lane run on home.
